description: Full-text search across the section index of a spec (`core` / `js-api` / `web-api`, set `spec`) — clause anchors/ids, titles, and prose. The entry point when you don't know the exact anchor. Returns ranked hits with a `matched_on` field (anchor-exact > title > anchor > prose) and a prose snippet for body matches; follow up with section_get.

query.description: Search text. Matched against clause anchors/ids, titles, and prose. E.g. `block type`, `trap`, `funcref`, `streaming compilation`.

spec.description: Which WebAssembly spec to query: `core` (default; instructions, types, validation, execution, formats), `js-api` (JavaScript embedding), or `web-api` (Web platform integration).

version.description: WebAssembly spec version to query. `latest` (default) is the current served version; `main` is the upstream working draft.

name: spec_search
title: Search spec
